:::{#sol-linear-system-check}

Yes.
The [matrix-vector product](#def-matvec-mult) is

$$
\ba
\matr{A}\vx
&= \begin{bmatrix} 3 \cd 2 + 1 \cd (-1) \\ 1 \cd 2 + (-2) \cd (-1) \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(@def-matvec-mult)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 5 \\ 4 \end{bmatrix},
&& \text{(multiply and add)}
\ea
$$

which equals $\vecf{b}$,
so $\vx$ is a [solution of the system](#def-linear-system).

:::
